Name: Jotaro Kujo Shane (jojo)
Author: bbobb25
Description:
A mod that changes Shane's sprites to look like Jotaro Kujo from Jojo's Bizarre Adventure.
My first mod, constructive criticism is welcomed.

The content.xnb goes in the loose files sprite folder, it's only there to fix some events.
Shane.xnb and shane_Jojamart.xnb go in the characters sprite folder.
The Shane.xnb in the shane portrait folder goes in the portraits folder.
All of these folders can be found in the content folder of Stardew Valley.
ALWAYS MAKE A BACKUP BEFORE REPLACING XNB FILES
